calendar_type_name.name: calendar_type_name
calendar_type_name.value: typeof("calendar_types"."name")='text' AND length(trim("calendar_types"."name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND instr("calendar_types"."name",char(0))=0

delivery_snapshot_text_valid.name: delivery_snapshot_text_valid
delivery_snapshot_text_valid.value: length("deliverable_snapshots"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND length("deliverable_snapshots"."note")<=200 AND length("deliverable_snapshots"."collection")<=80 AND length("deliverable_snapshots"."content_sha256")=64

delivery_snapshot_tags_valid.name: delivery_snapshot_tags_valid
delivery_snapshot_tags_valid.value: CASE WHEN json_valid("deliverable_snapshots"."tags") THEN json_type("deliverable_snapshots"."tags")='array' AND json_array_length("deliverable_snapshots"."tags")<=20 ELSE 0 END

finance_installment_date.name: finance_installment_date
finance_installment_date.value: length("finance_installments"."due_date") = 10 AND substr("finance_installments"."due_date",1,4) <> '0000' AND date("finance_installments"."due_date") IS NOT NULL AND date("finance_installments"."due_date") = "finance_installments"."due_date"

project_professional_fields_valid.name: project_professional_fields_valid
project_professional_fields_valid.value: CASE WHEN length(CAST("matters"."professional_fields" AS blob)) <= 28000 AND json_valid("matters"."professional_fields") THEN json_type("matters"."professional_fields") = 'object' AND json_remove("matters"."professional_fields", '$.civil_litigation', '$.criminal_litigation', '$.commercial_arbitration', '$.non_litigation', '$.contract_review') = '{}' AND COALESCE(json_type("matters"."professional_fields", '$.civil_litigation'), 'object') = 'object' AND COALESCE(json_type("matters"."professional_fields", '$.criminal_litigation'), 'object') = 'object' AND COALESCE(json_type("matters"."professional_fields", '$.commercial_arbitration'), 'object') = 'object' AND COALESCE(json_type("matters"."professional_fields", '$.non_litigation'), 'object') = 'object' AND COALESCE(json_type("matters"."professional_fields", '$.contract_review'), 'object') = 'object' ELSE 0 END

project_start_valid.name: project_start_valid
project_start_valid.value: "matters"."start_date" IS NULL OR (length("matters"."start_date") = 10 AND "matters"."start_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr("matters"."start_date",1,4) <> '0000' AND date("matters"."start_date") IS NOT NULL AND date("matters"."start_date") = "matters"."start_date")

project_target_valid.name: project_target_valid
project_target_valid.value: ("matters"."target_date" IS NULL OR (length("matters"."target_date") = 10 AND "matters"."target_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr("matters"."target_date",1,4) <> '0000' AND date("matters"."target_date") IS NOT NULL AND date("matters"."target_date") = "matters"."target_date")) AND ("matters"."start_date" IS NULL OR "matters"."target_date" IS NULL OR "matters"."start_date" <= "matters"."target_date")

project_tags_valid.name: project_tags_valid
project_tags_valid.value: CASE WHEN json_valid("matters"."tags") THEN json_type("matters"."tags") = 'array' AND json_array_length("matters"."tags") <= 20 ELSE 0 END

discussion_target.name: discussion_target
discussion_target.value: ("project_discussion"."kind" IN ('project_comment','update') AND "project_discussion"."update_id" IS NULL) OR ("project_discussion"."kind" = 'update_comment' AND "project_discussion"."update_id" IS NOT NULL)

task_calendar_planned_date_valid.name: task_calendar_planned_date_valid
task_calendar_planned_date_valid.value: planned_date IS NULL OR (typeof(planned_date)='text' AND length(planned_date)=10 AND planned_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(planned_date,1,4)<>'0000' AND date(planned_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(planned_date)=planned_date)

task_calendar_schedule_date_valid.name: task_calendar_schedule_date_valid
task_calendar_schedule_date_valid.value: schedule_date IS NULL OR (typeof(schedule_date)='text' AND length(schedule_date)=10 AND schedule_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(schedule_date,1,4)<>'0000' AND date(schedule_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(schedule_date)=schedule_date)

task_calendar_schedule_start_valid.name: task_calendar_schedule_start_valid
task_calendar_schedule_start_valid.value: schedule_start IS NULL OR (typeof(schedule_start)='text' AND schedule_start GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND schedule_start<'24:00')

task_calendar_schedule_end_valid.name: task_calendar_schedule_end_valid
task_calendar_schedule_end_valid.value: schedule_end IS NULL OR (typeof(schedule_end)='text' AND schedule_end GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND schedule_end<'24:00')

task_calendar_schedule_complete_valid.name: task_calendar_schedule_complete_valid
task_calendar_schedule_complete_valid.value: (schedule_date IS NULL AND schedule_start IS NULL AND schedule_end IS NULL AND schedule_timezone IS NULL) OR (schedule_date IS NOT NULL AND schedule_start IS NOT NULL AND schedule_end IS NOT NULL AND schedule_start<schedule_end AND typeof(schedule_timezone)='text' AND length(schedule_timezone) BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

task_calendar_important_type_valid.name: task_calendar_important_type_valid
task_calendar_important_type_valid.value: (important_type_id IS NULL AND is_important=0) OR (typeof(important_type_id)='text' AND length(important_type_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

task_calendar_attention_date_valid.name: task_calendar_attention_date_valid
task_calendar_attention_date_valid.value: attention_date IS NULL OR (typeof(attention_date)='text' AND length(attention_date)=10 AND attention_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr(attention_date,1,4)<>'0000' AND date(attention_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(attention_date)=attention_date)

task_calendar_attention_complete_valid.name: task_calendar_attention_complete_valid
task_calendar_attention_complete_valid.value: (attention_source='custom' OR (attention_date IS NULL AND attention_time IS NULL)) AND (attention_time IS NULL OR (attention_date IS NOT NULL AND (typeof(attention_time)='text' AND attention_time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND attention_time<'24:00')))

task_assignee_valid.name: task_assignee_valid
task_assignee_valid.value: "task_items"."assignee" IS NULL OR (typeof("task_items"."assignee") = 'text' AND instr("task_items"."assignee", char(0)) = 0 AND length(trim("task_items"."assignee")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

task_tags_valid.name: task_tags_valid
task_tags_valid.value: CASE WHEN json_valid("task_items"."tags") THEN json_type("task_items"."tags") = 'array' AND json_array_length("task_items"."tags") <= 20 ELSE 0 END

task_due_date_valid.name: task_due_date_valid
task_due_date_valid.value: "task_items"."due_date" IS NULL OR (length("task_items"."due_date") = 10 AND "task_items"."due_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr("task_items"."due_date",1,4) <> '0000' AND date("task_items"."due_date") IS NOT NULL AND date("task_items"."due_date") = "task_items"."due_date")
